name: finlens-financial-holdout-v1
corpus_policy: Full annual reports; company, report year and consolidated scope supplied as query metadata; no gold-page filtering.
question_design: 108 cases: 36 statement lookups + 10 note lookups + 4 cross-statement requests + 4 year comparisons per company. No paraphrase padding.
annotation: Assistant-authored and visually checked against rendered source tables; no second human adjudicator. Reference pages are canonical locations for the specified statement/note, not exhaustive semantic relevance judgments.
ranking: unchanged since ed4a45f: BM25, BGE-M3 dense threshold 0.25, RRF k=60, context fusion; top 5 chunks; common query vector per case
metrics: Macro mean of per-case distinct reference-page recall in top 5 chunks and truncated reciprocal rank of first reference-page hit; also literal label+value evidence coverage and complete-evidence MRR.
exclusions: No algorithm tuning on this test set
No claim of independent human labels or statistical generalization from two companies
